name: PG Backup & Restore
description: Back up and restore PostgreSQL databases with pg_dump / pg_restore / psql: custom, tar, directory and plain SQL dumps, schema/table selection, role backup, version checks, progress, backup history and an optional full schema reset before restore.
releaseNotes: SSL mode (PGSSLMODE) for cloud servers; the database list now falls back to postgres / template1; optional single-transaction restore that stops on the first error; ANALYZE after restore; a clear message when the dump file is compressed (.gz, .zst, .zip, …). Windows: pg_dump / pg_restore are found in C:\Program Files\PostgreSQL\<version>\bin when they are not on PATH (newest installed version) and no console window flashes; errors are also now shown in the Output panel. Declares host.binary, since the native backend runs the user's PostgreSQL client tools.
